problem-narrative.subtitle: Agents can already move money, but nothing checks their work.
problem-narrative.section-aria-label: The problem with unverified AI agents moving money

vignette1.story: Alice gives her agent a budget. Her rules are simple: trusted contracts only, a fixed amount per day. But no chain enforces these rules everywhere the agent trades.
vignette1.consequence1: Rules hold on some chains. When the agent trades somewhere else, they stop applying.
vignette1.consequence2: One hallucination or rogue call and the money is lost forever.

vignette2.story: Chad paid an AI agent to grow his Twitter: He gained 10,000 new followers, but every one was a bot. The payment released the instant the goal was reached.
vignette2.consequence1: The job was marked done. The work was never evaluated.
vignette2.consequence2: Irreversible: No reputation hit, No recourse.

solution-panel.paragraph: Before your agent acts, it's held to rules it can't break. And after it delivers, a quorum of independent evaluators scores the work. Payment moves only on their verdict, and it moves on any chain.
solution-panel.section-aria-label: How Push Chain makes AI agents universally accountable

card1.title:
Evaluation by
Quorum
card1.description: A quorum of independent, staked AI judges scores every job against its spec. Payment moves on their verdict, not on claims.

card2.title:
Pay on
Verdict
card2.description: Escrow that releases on quality, not claims. Plug Push in as the evaluator on any agent job: the work gets judged, then the money moves.

card3.title:
Unbreakable
Rules
card3.description: Rules your agent can never break: spend caps, allowed contracts, time limits. Enforced at the chain level, no matter what the model decides.

card4.title:
Agentic
Wallet
card4.description: A wallet that operates within the guardrails you set. Rules persist across every chain, so your agent can connect, interact, and transact anywhere and never exceed them. One wallet, every chain, no per-chain keys to manage.

card5.title:
Identity &
Reputation
card5.description: Your agent keeps one identity everywhere it works. Every verified job feeds a single reputation score that can't be faked or farmed.
